description:
Whether one date is a public holiday or non-working day in Ukraine.

`is_holiday` is true, false, or **null** -- null when `covered` is false, i.e.
the mirror has not computed that year. Null is not "no": a deadline calculation
must be able to tell "this is a working day" from "this source cannot say".

`matches` carries the day with its name and verbatim statute line; a list, as a
movable feast and a dated holiday can coincide.

`is_holiday` means ст. 73 lists the day. During martial law ст. 73 does not
apply: see `martial_law.suspends_holidays`, null past the decreed end.
name: ua_holidays__check_date
title: Check Ukrainian Holiday
